entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order or to make a return, please press one.
One.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. My order number is VF-8675309.
Certainly, I can help with that. Let me pull up your order... VF-8675309. I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered 18 days ago. Unfortunately, it looks like we're outside of our 10-day return window.

What? No, that can't be right. There has to be an exception. The item `was a gift` for my partner, and I was `traveling` for work right after it arrived. While I was gone, they had a medical emergency and ended up in the `hospital`. I just got back and this is the first chance I've had.
Oh my, I am so sorry to hear that. I truly hope your partner is recovering well. I can only imagine how stressful that must have been.
It was. And to make it worse, I tried to do the return online yesterday and your `website crashed` on me twice! This whole thing has been a nightmare. I just want to send it back.

I understand your frustration completely, and I sincerely apologize for the website issues on top of everything else. While I do have to adhere to the return policy, let me see what options we have. One moment.
This is ridiculous. Who even has a 10-day return window? Nobody reads the `fine print` for something like that. I expect a full refund.

I hear you, and I do sympathize with the difficult situation. While I am unable to process a refund to your original payment method due to the policy, I do want to make this right for you. What I can offer is a full store credit for the total value of the VeloBand Pulse.
Store credit? I don't know...

The credit would not expire, so you can use it whenever you're ready. And for the inconvenience you've experienced with our website and this entire situation, I'd also like to add a complimentary $25 credit to your account.
Wait, so I'd get the full amount back in store credit, plus an extra $25?
That's correct. It's the least we can do at VeloFit to help turn this experience around for you.
Oh. Wow, okay. That's... actually really helpful. That works for me. Thank you, I appreciate you doing that.

Of course. I'm happy we could find a solution. I've just applied the credits to your account. You'll receive an email confirmation within the next 15 minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, Alex. I was really getting frustrated.
I completely understand. You have a great day, and I wish your partner a speedy recovery. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
